# Visual transport fixture

`hopper.jpg` is Pillow's Grace Hopper photograph fixture, retrieved from
https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/main/Tests/images/hopper.jpg on
2026-10-12. Pillow distributes this image in its test suite under its repository
license: https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/main/LICENSE.

The integration test decodes and transmits the actual JPEG pixels. Its model
response is an explicit protocol fixture. It does not test recognition accuracy,
OCR quality, or FUPCJ hardware performance. Screenshot/text fixtures and the
video pattern are generated by the tests; no user media is in this repository.
